concoct_disorder.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。若以此方式有2张或更多牌被放入军械库，此牌获得再动。
concoct_disorder.text_en: When this attacks, each hero puts the top card of their deck face-down into their arsenal. If 2 or more cards are put into arsenals this way, this gets go again.

curative_ceremony.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，每位英雄若能则各治愈一个其控制的疾病。依此方式每治愈一个疾病，选择一个模式：
·此牌获得+2力量。
·此牌获得再动。
·此牌获得隐匿。
curative_ceremony.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, each hero cures a disease they control if able. Choose a mode for each disease cured this way;

This gets +2{p}.
This gets go again.
This gets veil.

descend_into_madness.text_zh: 随机放逐防御英雄手牌中的一张牌，然后该英雄抽一张牌。
descend_into_madness.text_en: Banish a random card from the defending hero's hand, then they draw a card.

exertion_bloom.text_zh:
在你的回合中，此牌使用费用减少3点资源。
由每位英雄各创造一个力竭衍生物。
exertion_bloom.text_en:
This costs {r}{r}{r} less to play during your turn.
Create an Exertion token under each hero's control.

extinction_level_event.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，指定一个疾病衍生物名称。当此牌在竞技场中时，具有所选名称的疾病衍生物失去且不能获得异能。
在你的回合开始时，若竞技场中有33个或更多疾病衍生物，你赢得本局游戏。
extinction_level_event.text_en:
When this enters the arena, name a disease token. Disease tokens with the chosen name lose and can't gain abilities while this is in the arena.
At the start of your turn, if there are 33 or more disease tokens in the arena, you win the game.

hyper_inflation.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本回合牌的使用费用增加1点资源。
再动
hyper_inflation.text_en:
When this attacks, cards cost {r} more to play this turn.
Go again

incite_aggression.text_zh:
每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝上置入其军械库。若一张红色牌依此方式牌面朝上置入军械库，你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。
再动
incite_aggression.text_en:
Each hero puts the top card of their deck face-up into their arsenal. If a red card is put face-up into an arsenal this way, your next attack this turn gets go again.
Go again

incite_resolve.text_zh:
每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝上置入其军械库。若一张蓝色牌依此方式牌面朝上置入军械库，你本回合的下一次攻击获得+2力量。
再动
incite_resolve.text_en:
Each hero puts the top card of their deck face-up into their arsenal. If a blue card is put face-up into an arsenal this way, your next attack this turn gets +2{p}.
Go again

induce_panic.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，选择一种颜色。每位英雄展示其手牌中的一张随机牌。若其为所选颜色，该英雄弃掉它。
induce_panic.text_en: When this defends, choose a color. Each hero reveals a random card from their hand. If it's the chosen color, they discard it.

quiet_streets.text_zh: 在当前链环上随机选择一张非装备牌。它在本链环中获得-3力量与-3防御。
quiet_streets.text_en: Choose a random non-equipment card on the active chain link. It gets -3{p} -3{d} this chain link.

raging_streets.text_zh: 在当前链环上随机选择一张非装备牌。它在本链环中获得+3力量与+3防御。
raging_streets.text_en: Choose a random non-equipment card on the active chain link. It gets +3{p} +3{d} this chain link.

riddle_with_regret.text_zh:
再动
在每位英雄的结束阶段开始时，该英雄失去X点生命，X为此效果触发时其控制的光环数量。若X为3或更高，摧毁此牌。
riddle_with_regret.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of each hero's end phase, they lose X{h}, where X is the number of auras they controlled when this triggered. If X is 3 or more, destroy this.

schism_of_chaos.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌被资源时，每位英雄洗牌，然后将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。
schism_of_chaos.text_en:
Legendary
When this is pitched, each hero shuffles, then puts the top card of their deck facedown into their arsenal.

spur_locked.text_zh:
每位英雄秘密选择一个1到6之间的数字，然后这些数字被展示。选择最高数字的英雄失去等量生命，搜寻其牌库中一张费用小于或等于所选数字的牌，展示它，将其置入其手牌，然后洗牌。
再动
spur_locked.text_en:
Each hero secretly chooses a number between 1 and 6, then those numbers are revealed. The hero that chose the highest number loses that much {h}, searches their deck for a card with cost less than or equal to the chosen number, reveales it, puts it in their hand, then shuffles.
Go again

swap_spit.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，随机选择一个你控制的疾病衍生物。目标对手随机选择一个其控制的疾病衍生物。将它们互相交给对方。
swap_spit.text_en: When this defends, choose a disease token you control at random. Target opponent chooses a disease token they control at random. Give them to each other.

tome_of_pandemonium.text_zh:
放逐每位英雄牌库顶的一张牌。本回合你可以使用它们。
再动
tome_of_pandemonium.text_en:
Banish the top card of each hero's deck. You may play them this turn.
Go again
